summary: The change validates device approval actions before any device-code lookup or state transition, accepts only approve and deny, and adds coverage for all requested invalid and valid action forms.

evidence: src/passport.ts:2043-2045 rejects every action other than the exact strings approve and deny with HTTP 400 before any device-code lookup or mutation.
src/handler_test.ts:3681-3695 covers omitted, misspelled, object, and numeric actions and verifies each leaves the device pending.
src/handler_test.ts:3697-3717 verifies both explicit valid actions, with deny and approve succeeding.
